name: Backend Data Flow
observations: DataAdapter.normalize(): Serializes data with conditions/actions from container parameters
Parameters used: coreshop.product_quantity_price_rules.calculators (calculation behaviour)
Parameters used: coreshop.product_quantity_price_rules.actions (pricing behaviour)
DataAdapter.getDataForSetter(): Receives rules data and calls fieldDefinition.getDataFromEditmode()
Frontend data format: { rules: [...], stores: { calculationBehaviourTypes, pricingBehaviourTypes } }
Backend response includes: conditions (array of type strings), actions (array of type strings)

name: Key Data Types
observations: QuantityPriceRule: id, name, calculationBehaviour, priority, active, conditions[], ranges[]
QuantityRange: id, rangeStartingFrom, pricingBehaviour, amount, percentage, currency, highlighted
CalculationBehaviour: 'by_quantity' | 'by_percentage' | 'by_price'
PricingBehaviour: 'fixed' | 'percentage_decrease' | 'percentage_increase' | 'amount_decrease' | 'amount_increase'
RuleCondition: Reuses @coreshop/rule types (from RuleBundle)

name: IndexBundle_SelectedFields_Implementation
observations: Two main display components: SelectedFieldsCards (card view) and SelectedFieldsTree (tree/list view)
SelectedFieldsTree has context menu with Edit and Delete options already implemented
SelectedFieldsCards uses button controls (EditOutlined, DeleteOutlined buttons in Card extra property)
Both components support drag-and-drop field reordering
FieldEditModal provides modal dialog for editing field configuration with getter/interpreter settings
ColumnsPanel orchestrates the layout using SplitLayout with ClassDefinitionTree on left and SelectedFieldsTree on right

name: SelectedFieldsTree_ContextMenu
observations: Located at: /src/CoreShop/Bundle/IndexBundle/Resources/assets/pimcore-studio/src/modules/indexes/components/SelectedFieldsTree.tsx (lines 176-203)
Uses Antd Dropdown component with trigger='contextMenu' for right-click menu
Dropdown wraps div with flexbox layout for title display
Context menu items: Edit (EditOutlined icon) and Delete (DeleteOutlined icon with danger=true)
Edit action calls onEdit(column, index) callback
Delete action calls handleDelete(index) which filters columns array
Field nodes rendered with: icon, name, columnType in small text
Each field has unique key: field-${index}
Tree structure has root node containing all selected fields as leaf nodes
